teaser.en: Clouds of white flowers cover this small coastal tree, a quiet relative of the hibiscus and cotton.
teaser.sw: Mawingu ya maua meupe hufunika mti huu mdogo wa pwani, jamaa mtulivu wa mbugi (hibiscus) na mpamba.

summary.en: *Mbwale* is a small coastal tree or shrub with heart-shaped leaves and clusters of white flowers. Like other Dombeyas it gives fibre and poles.
summary.sw: *Mbwale* ni mti mdogo au kichaka cha pwani chenye majani ya umbo la moyo na vishada vya maua meupe. Kama mimea mingine ya jenasi ya *Dombeya*, hutoa nyuzi na nguzo.

about.en: *Mbwale* is a small tree or shrub with soft, heart-shaped leaves. It flowers in dense clusters of small white blossoms, which can cover the crown. It belongs to the mallow family, which also includes hibiscus and cotton.
about.sw: *Mbwale* ni mti mdogo au kichaka chenye majani laini ya umbo la moyo. Huchanua vishada vizito vya maua madogo meupe, ambayo yanaweza kufunika taji lote. Ni wa familia ya mibamia, ambayo pia inajumuisha mbugi (hibiscus) na mpamba.

where.en: It grows on coastal forest edges, in wooded grassland and in bushland. It is most noticeable when flowering.
where.sw: Huota pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani, katika nyika zenye miti na vichakani. Huonekana zaidi unapochanua.

uses.en: Dombeyas are generally used for their tough bark fibre, for tying and rope, and for poles, and *mbwale* is used in similar ways.
uses.sw: Kwa kawaida mimea ya jenasi ya *Dombeya* hutumika kwa nyuzi ngumu za gome lake, kwa kufungia na kusokotea kamba, na kwa nguzo, na *mbwale* hutumika kwa njia hizo hizo.

names.en: The Digo and Swahili name is *mbwale*. It is recorded in ICRAF's handbook under a related species, *Dombeya rotundifolia*, so the name may cover more than one Dombeya. No English common name has been recorded for *Dombeya taylorii*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo na la Kiswahili ni *mbwale*. Limerekodiwa katika kitabu cha ICRAF chini ya spishi jamaa, *Dombeya rotundifolia*, kwa hiyo huenda jina hili linajumuisha zaidi ya spishi moja ya *Dombeya*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa kwa *Dombeya taylorii*.

reason.en: Grewia, another bush shrub of the mallow family
reason.sw: *Grewia*, kichaka kingine cha vichakani cha familia ya mibamia
*Thespesia danis*, kichaka cha familia ya mibamia
*Carpodiptera*, mti mwingine wa familia ya mibamia
